description:
User approved this review fix on 2026-11-28 after discussion of finding 1.

Problem: Executor.prepare_attachments/1 for upload_then_publish completes uploads but does not prepare every publication before sending. Reproduced at 6a546dc44: two groups, abort policy, encoded-message limit 10; first answer sends, second continuation fails preparation with size_limit. Preparation failures that are knowable before publication must publish nothing.

Agreed fix: after uploads, preflight every publication request before the first send under abort. On any preparation failure, block all publication and report failed/unattempted parts through existing DeliveryConfirmation -> Event/NodeRouter -> Engine. Preserve uploaded-only evidence without claiming delivery. Keep policy/orchestration in Executor and preparation validation in Preparation; bridges encode or execute one operation only. Plan stays metadata-only and Channels-local.

Dynamic-header exception: actual root/thread IDs may only exist after first publication. Re-encode/revalidate final inputs before each send. A newly discoverable final-header overflow or provider failure stops subsequent publication and reports confirmed and failed/unattempted parts; do not undo already confirmed messages or retry operations.

Tests: extend the existing abort preparation regression in test/zaq/channels/delivery/executor_test.exs across direct and upload_then_publish modes, using existing DeliveryExecutionBridge/DeliveryPreparationBridge. Assert no publication for a later preflight encoding failure; retain upload-only facts, grouped reporting, sequential sends, stop after provider failure, and dynamic-header recheck behavior. Preserve existing assertions; user approval covers this extension, not weakening unrelated tests.

Action reuse assessment: extend existing Channel-local Executor and Preparation; reuse bridge preparation callbacks and DeliveryConfirmation reporting. No new Action, provider-policy runtime, or parallel send/history route. Inputs remain separate Outgoing, Plan and trusted selected connection. No new permissions or retries. Verify through existing executor/reporting suites.

Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and docs/services/channels.md before implementation. Update owning service/module documentation if needed. Follow issue validation lifecycle. This issue records approved work; this conversation is reviewing remaining findings before implementation.

comments.text: Rechecked approved scope and Action reuse against Executor.execute/5, Preparation.prepare_step/5, existing bridge callbacks and Result.safe_evidence/1. Extend Executor preflight after upload completion; preserve final re-encoding with actual root headers. No new Action or provider/reporting path. Existing executor regressions cover acquisition, deadlines, sequential abort and confirmation; extend them across both transfer modes.

Implemented and validated in working tree. Before fix, extended upload regression failed because first publication escaped; after fix mix q passed and focused Executor/PreparationAttempt/AttemptReporting/Result suites passed: 53 checks (4 properties, 49 tests). Both transfer modes now preflight abort publications; uploaded-only refs remain private facts, no sends escape a static preparation failure, and final changed-root headers are revalidated. No commit/push/merge; keep in progress until normal landing lifecycle.
